---

## Overview

FFXIV Config v0.2.0 delivers an updated configuration package aligned with Final Fantasy XIV Dawntrail (8.x). This release updates character HUD layouts, keybinds, and combat job hotbars based on Fr4nsson's FFC with full attribution, standardizes the project under the MIT license, adds high-resolution preview artwork, and deploys a complete community-health suite.

---

## Highlights

- **8.x Dawntrail Synchronization**: Updated all configuration `.DAT` files in `src/` for 8.x job rotations and layouts.
- **In-Game Preview Asset**: High-resolution in-game HUD and hotbar preview asset (`.github/assets/preview.jpg`).
- **Standardized Licensing**: Clear MIT licensing across all manifests with explicit attribution to Fr4nsson's original FFC layout.
- **Community Health & Governance**: Standard `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`, `SECURITY.md`, `SUPPORT.md`, `PRIVACY.md`, `GOVERNANCE.md`, `CITATION.cff`, and issue/PR templates.
- **Decoupled Minimal Entry Point**: `README.md` streamlined as a minimal entry point directing to centralized documentation at [docs.helix-origin.club/ffxiv-config](https://docs.helix-origin.club/ffxiv-config/).

## What's Changed

### Added
- High-resolution in-game HUD & hotbar preview asset (`.github/assets/preview.jpg`).
- Project-local agents ecosystem (`AGENTS.md`, `.agents/rules/`, `.github/copilot-instructions.md`).
- Self-contained community-health suite (`CONTRIBUTING.md`, `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`, `SECURITY.md`, `SUPPORT.md`, `PRIVACY.md`, `TOS.md`, `GOVERNANCE.md`, `CITATION.cff`).
- Dedicated project-local tracking ledgers (`ROADMAP.md`, `PLAN.md`, `TODO.md`, `BUGS.md`, `HANDOFF.md`).

### Changed
- Updated character configuration `.DAT` files (`ADDON.DAT`, `CONTROL0.DAT`, `CONTROL1.DAT`, `GEARSET.DAT`, `HOTBAR.DAT`, `ITEMFDR.DAT`, `ITEMODR.DAT`, `KEYBIND.DAT`, `MACRO.DAT`, `UISAVE.DAT`).
- Aligned project license to MIT across all manifests.
- Converted `README.md` to minimal entry point linking to centralized documentation.
